conditions.evidence: Sleep scoring in mice, variability between labs
conditions.label: sleep

modalities.evidence: EEG recordings with sleep scores from 92 healthy mice
at least one EEG and one EMG channel

output.population: 92 healthy mice from five laboratories, recorded in dark and light phases
output.summary: EEG and EMG recordings with expert sleep scores from healthy mice, collected at five laboratories to study scoring variability between labs. BIDS-formatted, stored as EDF, downsampled, with four-second scoring epochs.
